browser_runtime: Chrome headless at 1100x800, CSS timelines at 0ms and 700ms
findings: HTML contains one SVG and seven active CSS animations; no JavaScript exceptions or external requests observed.

At 700ms both wheels have moved away from the bicycle frame. CSS .wheel uses transform-origin:center without transform-box:fill-box or explicit per-wheel origins, so rotation uses the SVG viewport reference box.
Legs and the two simplified pedal dots have no pedaling animation; whole-body bouncing does not fulfill a complete cycling motion.
scope: One stochastic sample. This does not establish whether the defect is caused by quantization, backend floating-point differences, speculative sampling, or ordinary generation variability.
